notes: The rebate began with Ontario's HST on July 1, 2010; 2013-04-01 is OpenTaxRate's floor. The threshold is the total of all qualifying items in one sale, not a per-item test, and non-qualifying items in the same sale are ignored. GI-064 says buyers 'generally' get the rebate at the till; if the vendor does not credit it, the buyer can claim it from the CRA. Seller-prepared food that is zero-rated federally stays at 0%. Whether a delivery charge counts toward the $4 total is unverified. Catering: neither GI-064 nor ontario.ca mentions catering, so no ON catering rule is given. The threshold is '$4.00 or less' (GI-064: 'must not be more than $4'). GI-064's Examples 3, 5, 8 and 9 give the rebate at the till on totals of exactly $4.00. Example 6 (a $4.00 sale charged the full 13%) sits under 'Filing rebate claims with the CRA': it shows a vendor that did not credit the rebate and the buyer claiming it back, not a sale over the limit. Checked 2026-10-30.

citations.quote: mittens, and gloves in sizes and styles designed for children or babies

notes: The rebate covers children's garments and footwear; accessories aren't in its list, and sports-only garments and footwear are excluded. Dated by GI-063 (August 2014) as the clothing rule.

summary: Ontario's children's clothing rebate doesn't reach protective gear or clothing and footwear used only for sports: the HST follows the federal GST/HST base.

citations.title: CRA, GST/HST rebate – Provincial point-of-sale rebate on qualifying items (reason code 16 eligibility)
citations.quote: Books, children's clothing and footwear, children's diapers, children's car seats, qualifying newspapers, and qualifying prepared food and beverages

citations.title: CRA, reason code 16 eligibility (not qualifying)
citations.quote: Children’s garments of a class that is used exclusively in sports or recreational activities

notes: The rebate covers children's garments and footwear; accessories aren't in its list, and sports-only garments and footwear are excluded. Dated by GI-063 (August 2014) as the clothing rule.

summary: Ontario's HST follows the federal GST/HST base here: CRA lists no Ontario point-of-sale rebate that covers this code.
